$comment: Studio examples gallery index (GUI.md III.7 / W10). Every entry maps one examples/*.py script to its Studio scene. Tier A = runs today through registered ops and is locked by examples_gallery.rs; Tier B/C name the milestone that unlocks them. Tier A scenes are also verified by rendering each one (examples_gallery.rs); the raster example uses a downsampled overlay fixture for the memory budget.
